title: Settling Balances Across a Resident's Private Pay Long-Term Care Residency Agreements
content:
**Patient accounts standard — Private Pay Long-Term Care Residency.** Balances are settled across all of a resident's private-pay agreements:

1. Before any credit balance on one agreement is refunded, it is applied to open charges on the resident's other agreements, oldest service month first, and only the remainder is refunded.
2. Collection referral looks at the resident's combined past-due balance across agreements.

**Restated as condition and result.**

| Situation | Result |
|---|---|
| A credit balance stands on one agreement and another agreement of the resident has open charges | The credit pays those open charges first, oldest service month first; the remainder, if any, is refunded |
| A credit balance stands and no other agreement of the resident has open charges | The credit balance is refunded |
| A referral to collections is considered | The past-due balances of all the resident's agreements are taken together |

**Hypothetical case.** A credit balance of 900.00 stands on a discharged agreement; an earlier agreement of the same resident has open charges of 250.00 for one service month and 400.00 for a later one. The credit pays 250.00 and then 400.00, and 250.00 remains to be refunded.
